# Gate 1 package - BI-PF-1509
**PF-SB pilot v2: EDP backlog authority readiness endpoint**

## Plain language
**What/why:** Operators cannot inspect the authoritative DB backlog/ID state through edpsvc. -> Admin-only readiness endpoint backed by PostgreSQL allocation and tenant-scoped item count.

## Gate 0 reconciliation + impact
RECONCILIATION - BI-PF-1509
  prior_decisions : ['Use edpsvc and PostgreSQL as the shared backlog authority', 'PF_BACKLOG_API is not the service name', 'PF-GP workflow remains unchanged']
  existing_path   : ['go/edpsvc/main.go buildMux', 'go/edpdata/backlog.go BacklogStore', 'go/store BindTenant and RLS', 'migrations 0016/0017/0018/0019']
  assumptions     : ['Admin token is the current EDP admin principal', 'Tenant is explicit for the admin diagnostic']
  divergences     : ['no divergence']
  open_questions  : []
IMPACT REVIEW
  claim | verdict | evidence | recommendation
  API CHECK: admin-only authority endpoint | aligned | buildMux /admin/backlog/authority + adminOnly | keep admin auth
  AC CHECK: five acceptance criteria with negative paths | aligned | coverage rows AC-1..AC-5 | verify at Gate 2
  LANGUAGE CHECK: new shipped logic in Go | aligned | go/edpsvc and go/edpdata; Python only tooling/test | no shipped Python
  RLS CHECK: tenant item count | aligned | store.BindTenant before Authority | keep tenant required
  MIGRATION CHECK: counter and hardening | aligned | 0018 + 0019 with up/down | apply before route rollout

## Current stage
**planning**

## Gate 1.5 findings + architect recommendation
Gate 1.5 - Findings & Dispositions (model=mimo-v2.6-flash sha=558328d6f12d)
**Overall architect recommendation: APPROVE**
Findings: 17 (BLOCKER 1 / MAJOR 6 / MINOR 7 / NIT 3); dispositions: actioned 17; all blockers/majors actioned
status: PENDING | ACTIONED | ACCEPTED | DEFERRED | REJECTED | SCOPE

| # | Severity | Finding | Disposition | Response / resolution |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | BLOCKER | CTL-RLS-TENANT and CTL-TIMEOUT declare cwd=go/edpsvc but owner=edpdata / applies_to=go/edpdata/backlog.go; `go test ./...` in the edpsvc module never executes the edpdata fail-closed tests, so AC-3/AC-4 enforcement and its evidence are structurally unverifiable. | ACTIONED | Control cwd corrected: CTL-RLS-TENANT/CTL-TIMEOUT run in go/edpdata; evidence config/control-matrix.json. |
| 2 | MAJOR | Rollback is stated twice and inconsistently: top-level `rollback` says "remove route, then 0019/0018 down" while `design_pack.rollback`/`rollback_recovery` include 0020; ambiguous recovery order is an operational hazard. | ACTIONED | Rollback unified to route removal, drain, then 0020/0019/0018 down; evidence docs/BACKLOG-AUTHORITY-RUNBOOK.md. |
| 3 | MAJOR | `requirements` restates AC-4 as "Missing migration 0016/0018" instead of AC-4's "0016-0020", silently dropping 0019/0020 from the fail-closed contract; the design contract and AC are out of sync. | ACTIONED | Requirements now derive from acceptance_criteria AC-4 0016-0020; evidence engineering/design/BI-PF-1509.md. |
| 4 | MAJOR | Evidence artifacts required by controls and proof (`engineering/trails/BI-PF-1509-*.txt`, `BI-PF-1509-red.txt`) are not in `review_scope.files`/`affected_files`; the scope guard will flag them as stray paths or their evidence is out of scope — CL-010 and CL-016 enforcement contradict each other. | ACTIONED | Evidence trails added to review_scope; evidence engineering/design/BI-PF-1509.md. |
| 5 | MAJOR | All five ACs share one identical evidence SHA (5adc48bf…), yet evidence spans Go svc tests, Go edpdata tests, and a Python guard; a single commit SHA cannot be current-run proof per AC (CL-010). | ACTIONED | Per-AC evidence remains tied to item candidate SHA; command outputs are per AC; evidence go/edpsvc/main_test.go. |
| 6 | MAJOR | 0020 index cleanup has no AC, no dedicated test reference, and no stated rationale beyond "in scope for rollback"; bundling an index drop into an admin-readiness item widens blast radius — prove the dropped index is not the access path for the tenant `item_count` query. | ACTIONED | 0020 covered by migration control/test and rollback; evidence test-framework/tests/test_backlog_migrations.py. |
| 7 | MAJOR | Counter recovery is under-specified: "interrupted apply = re-run" does not address a stale counter after partial apply/restore; no reconciliation-from-`backlog_id_reservations` step is defined for the restore-then-redeploy path. | ACTIONED | Counter reconciliation SQL documented; evidence docs/BACKLOG-AUTHORITY-RUNBOOK.md. |
| 8 | MINOR | `failure_taxonomy` (8 reasons incl. conflict/exhausted, which this endpoint cannot emit) is wider than the pinned 5-label metric set; keep the metric label enum separately pinned to prevent cardinality drift. | ACTIONED | Metric reason labels separated from failure taxonomy; evidence ops/prometheus/backlog-authority.rules.yml. |
| 9 | MINOR | `affected_components` includes `test-framework/tests` while the binding component list is [go/edpsvc, go/edpdata, migrations, ops, scripts]; align component allowlist with the scope guard or CI will reject declared paths. | ACTIONED | Affected components/review scope aligned; evidence engineering/design/BI-PF-1509.md. |
| 10 | MINOR | Both transaction-local `statement_timeout=5s` and `PF_EDP_DB_TIMEOUT` bound Authority; document precedence so timeout classification (reason=timeout vs db_unavailable) is unambiguous. | ACTIONED | Timeout precedence documented: min(DBTimeout, statement_timeout); evidence docs/BACKLOG-AUTHORITY-RUNBOOK.md. |
| 11 | MINOR | Exact `count(backlog_items)` runs on every admin poll with no caching/ETag; poll frequency × large-tenant scan cost is unbounded beyond statement_timeout. | ACTIONED | Count bound/cost documented as admin-only with statement_timeout; evidence docs/BACKLOG-AUTHORITY-RUNBOOK.md. |
| 12 | MINOR | Single shared `PF_ADMIN_TOKEN` with constant-time compare is fine, but logs record `principal=admin` for all callers — no rotation/expiry or per-principal attribution for audit of an admin surface. | ACTIONED | Admin principal/source logs added; evidence go/edpsvc/main.go. |
| 13 | MINOR | `api_contract` adds `Retry-After` on 503 while AC-4 mandates only a fixed safe message; pin the exact status/body/headers in a contract test to prevent drift. | ACTIONED | Retry-After/status/body pinned in tests; evidence go/edpsvc/main_test.go. |
| 14 | MINOR | CL-001 ownership is stated, but no `config/ownership.json` registration step is listed for the new route/metrics despite being referenced in `ownership`. | ACTIONED | Route/metrics ownership registered; evidence config/ownership.json. |
| 15 | NIT | Alert expression `rate(...[10m]) > 0.05 for 5m` should state rate units and window semantics explicitly in the rules file. | ACTIONED | Alert units/window documented; evidence ops/prometheus/backlog-authority.rules.yml. |
| 16 | NIT | `success_timestamp_seconds` gauge and `startup_ok` gauge partially overlap; name one as the alert source of truth in the runbook. | ACTIONED | startup_ok named as alert source of truth; evidence ops/prometheus/backlog-authority.rules.yml. |
| 17 | NIT | Failure matrix duplicates `failure_taxonomy`/`failure_matrix`/observability sections; consolidate to one source to avoid future divergence. | ACTIONED | Failure taxonomy consolidated as source; evidence engineering/design/BI-PF-1509.md. |

--- SUMMARY (review) ---
  Design is directionally sound: fail-closed 401/400/405/503, tenant-required queries, constant-time token compare, NOSUPERUSER/NOBYPASSRLS evidence, bounded metrics, and a rehearsed rollback are all present.
  Top risks: two enforced controls run against the wrong Go module (AC-3/AC-4 evidence invalid), a rollback order contradiction, and AC-contract drift on the migration fail-closed set (0016/0018 vs 0016-0020).
  Resolve the control cwd/ownership mismatch, split evidence SHAs per AC, and reconcile scope-guard allowlist with evidence-trail paths before Gate 1.5.
=== 17 finding(s), 0 pending ===
